name: univerlist
description: Track everything you watch, read and play. Local-first: your library lives in your browser and moves as an export.

scripts.build: vite build && node tools/pack-extensions.ts extensions dist/extensions && node tools/no-test-hook.ts dist
scripts.build:file: vite build --mode file && node tools/no-test-hook.ts dist-file
scripts.build:e2e: vite build --mode e2e && node tools/pack-extensions.ts extensions dist-e2e/extensions && pnpm build:e2e:file
scripts.build:e2e:file: vite build --mode file-e2e && node tools/pack-extensions.ts extensions dist-file-e2e/extensions && node tools/no-test-hook.ts --has dist-file-e2e
scripts.test: pnpm lint && pnpm check && pnpm test:unit && pnpm test:e2e
scripts.test:stress: pnpm build:e2e:file && node tests/stress/memory.ts && node tests/stress/insights.ts && node tests/stress/overview.ts && node tests/stress/shell.ts && node tests/stress/library-load.ts && node tests/stress/reader-big.ts
